evidence_quotes: Meststoffenwet. Artikel 23, derde en zesde lid, van de Meststoffenwet (Msw).
Fosfaatrechten. Gegrond beroep i.v.m. niet meetellen op peildatum afgevoerde dieren.
rationale: This CBb decision concerns agricultural phosphate production rights (fosfaatrechten) and exemptions for dairy cattle farming under the Dutch Meststoffenwet (Msw), explicitly excluded from water governance under the protocol (the Dutch term 'peildatum' refers to a statutory reference date, not water levels).
